root_text: Nifty & Bank Nifty fell -1.6% and -2%+ on HMPV scare. Jan-Feb are historically weak, with avg Jan returns at -0.59%. Weak FII flows, strong dollar, & rising US yields add pressure. Q3 earnings now in focus. https://t.co/eWNHuNS0M9
